about_the_game:
Unlock more mysteries in the DLC for "Mind Echoes: Remnants of the Past"! The echoes grow louder… In this gripping DLC, the story continues across four all-new, fully animated hidden object locations, each rich with eerie atmosphere, intricate puzzles, and long-forgotten secrets. Dive deeper into the lore of the cursed kingdom, challenge your perception of the past, and unearth chilling truths that were buried—until now.

Fresh layers of lore and character backstories, dozens of new hidden items and collectible secrets, new achievements and unlockables are waiting for you to join and continue your journey!

🕯️ Explore the Medieval Museum!

Step into a medieval museum filled with cryptic exhibits, ancient relics, and long-lost records. Examine knight armor, paintings, and forgotten manuscripts to learn more about the origins of Turnwald and the forces behind the ghostly knight’s oath!

🕯️ Unravel a Ghostly Tavern’s Story!

A spectral tavern in a village outside time becomes your next destination. Interact with the ghost of a tavern keeper, but beware—he won’t speak unless you can solve the riddles that bind him to this place!

🕯️ Crack the Secrets of the Library!

Among shelves of crumbling books and hidden compartments lies the truth about Turnwald’s fall. Match giant puzzle pieces, unlock secret archives, and search for documents the kingdom tried to erase from history.

🕯️ Enter the Silver Moon’s Secret Lair!

Delve into a chamber once used by mystics and mediums. This mysterious sanctuary holds deep insights into the world of spirit communication, forgotten rituals, and the truth about the Silver Moon’s role in the fractured timeline. But powerful puzzles guard every step.

Download the "Mind Echoes: Remnants of the Past" – DLC now and uncover what lies beyond the echoes!
